title: Guaranteed Delivery Terms for Marketplace Orders
content:
**Clause in force.** On Marketplace Orders, an order whose shipping charge was zero earns nothing under this policy, and options without guaranteed delivery never earn it.

**Retired clauses.** The following former clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis for late deliveries:

- "On a delivery option with guaranteed delivery, an order whose delivery promise is recorded as missed earns a refund of the shipping charge actually paid on the order, booked as the late-delivery shipping component and funded by the option's liability party."
- "The request must be made within the late refund request window counted in calendar days from the delivered date."

## Reading the clause in force

| Delivery option guarantees delivery | Shipping charge paid on the order | Earned under this policy |
|---|---|---|
| no | any | nothing, ever |
| yes | zero | nothing |

The options without guaranteed delivery are Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping and Fulfilled by Northloop Standard.

### Hypothetical cases

1. A hypothetical Loop+ member's order on Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day carried a USD 0.00 shipping charge; the order earns nothing under this policy.
2. A hypothetical order on Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping arrives after its promised delivery date; the option does not guarantee delivery, so it never earns anything under this policy.

superseded_clauses: On a delivery option with guaranteed delivery, an order whose delivery_promise_met is missed earns a refund of the shipping charge actually paid on the order, booked as the late_delivery_shipping component and funded by the option's liability party.
The request must be made within the late refund request window counted in calendar days from the delivered_date.
